The staged route handlers mostly honor their narrow contract, but two higher-risk gaps sit in the browser/session integration layer and are not covered by the current regression tests.I’m grabbing exact line anchors for the two findings so the review points back to the concrete failure points rather than just the surrounding files.**Findings**
1. Major: the layout-finalize UI can claim success even when the staged backend path has failed. In `web/layout-instruction.js#L501` we swallow failures from both confirm-layout and generate-final, then still post layout-complete and unconditionally show “Layout confirmed and final output generated” at `web/layout-instruction.js#L540`. The backend contract in `scripts/routes/generation_routes.py#L451` explicitly returns 400 or 500 on real failures, so this frontend behavior can move the session to refinement while leaving Dr. Greg on stale pre-layout artifacts.

2. Major: a page reload during layout review can erase the applied-layout audit trail. The browser-side history is only the transient window.layoutInstructions array, which is initialized locally at `web/layout-instruction.js#L381` and “restored” only by re-rendering that same in-memory list at `web/layout-instruction.js#L418`. But the server already persists staged instructions and even exposes them via `scripts/routes/review_routes.py#L982`. After a reload, completeLayoutReview posts the now-empty browser list back through layout-complete from `web/layout-instruction.js#L501`, and ConversationManager overwrites the durable record at `scripts/utils/conversation_manager.py#L872`. So we can silently lose the record of layout changes just by refreshing before finalizing.

3. Major: the confirmed final outputs are not persisted in the session state that the rest of the app restores. The staged final route writes paths only into generation_state.final_output_paths at `scripts/routes/generation_routes.py#L485`, while status still exposes only generated_files at `scripts/routes/status_routes.py#L105`. On restore, the browser repopulates the CV/download state from generated_files at `web/session-manager.js#L348` and separately reads generation-state at `web/session-manager.js#L355`, but it never rehydrates the confirmed final HTML/PDF from final_output_paths. That means a reload or reopened session can fall back to the pre-layout files instead of the confirmed staged outputs.

## Investigation Complete: File Review Click Path Root Cause

### **Root Cause: Missing `populateDownloadTab()` Function**

The "File Review" tab has a broken click path because **`populateDownloadTab()` is called in multiple places but is NOT defined in any current source file**. It was only present in the old monolithic `index.html.backup`.

---

### **Evidence of Missing Function**

**Where it's referenced:**

1. [web/review-table-base.js](web/review-table-base.js#L17) — Listed in JSDoc dependencies
2. [web/review-table-base.js](web/review-table-base.js#L164) — **Called for 'download' tab**: `await populateDownloadTab(tabData.cv)`
3. [web/ui-core.js](web/ui-core.js#L439) — **Conditional call**: `if (typeof populateDownloadTab === 'function' && ...)`
4. [web/ui-core.js](web/ui-core.js#L625) — **Called during generation**: `await populateDownloadTab(response.generated_files)`
5. [web/bundle.js](web/bundle.js#L1425) — Present in bundled code (**stale artifact** from old build)

**Where it SHOULD be defined (but isn't):**
- ✗ No `web/download-tab.js` or similar
- ✗ No function in any other `.js` file
- ✓ Only found in [web/index.html.backup](web/index.html.backup#L3831) (line 3831-3970)

---

### **Why Bundle.js Has It**

The `web/bundle.js` contains the function because it was built from the old monolithic architecture. However, the source code was refactored into modular files (spell-check.js, finalise.js, cover-letter.js, etc.) **but the download tab function was never extracted to a separate file**.

---

### **What the Function Should Do** 
Based on [index.html.backup lines 3831-3970](web/index.html.backup#L3831):
- Render "Download Generated Files" heading
- Fetch `/api/ats-validate` to get validation checks
- Display ATS validation report (pass/warn/fail counts)
- Show page count badge with warnings if >3 pages
- Render download buttons for .pdf, .docx, .html files
- Block format-specific buttons based on validation failures
- Show helpful error messages

+  const rawFiles = Array.isArray(cvData.files) ? cvData.files : [];
+  const candidateFiles = [
+    ...rawFiles,
+    cvData.final_html,
+    cvData.final_pdf,
+    cvData.html,
+    cvData.pdf,
+    cvData.docx,
+    cvData.ats_docx,
+  ].filter(Boolean);
+
+  for (const filename of candidateFiles) {
+    if (seen.has(filename)) continue;
+    seen.add(filename);
+
+    let icon = '📁';
+    let description = 'Generated file';
+    let format = 'other';
+
+    if (filename.endsWith('.pdf')) {
+      icon = filename.includes('ATS') ? '🤖' : '📄';
+      description = filename.includes('ATS')
+        ? 'ATS-optimised PDF — machine-readable for automated screening'
+        : 'Human-readable PDF — for human reviewers and printing';
+      format = 'pdf';
+    } else if (filename.endsWith('.docx')) {
+      icon = '📝';
+      description = filename.includes('ATS')
+        ? 'ATS-optimised Word document — keyword-optimised for job applications'
+        : 'Human-readable Word document — editable format';
+      format = 'docx';
+    } else if (filename.endsWith('.html')) {
+      icon = '🌐';
+      description = 'HTML format with embedded JSON-LD structured data';
+      format = 'html';
+    } else if (filename === 'job_description.txt') {
+      icon = '📋';
+      description = 'Original job description reference';
+    }
+
+    files.push({ filename, description, icon, format });
+  }
+
+  return files;
+}
+
+function _renderValidationSummary(checks, summary, pageCount, atsError) {
+  let html = '';
+
+  if (pageCount !== null) {
+    const pageWarning = pageCount < 1.5 || pageCount > 3;
+    html += `<div style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
+              background:${pageWarning ? '#fef9c3' : '#f0fdf4'};
+              border:1px solid ${pageWarning ? '#fde047' : '#bbf7d0'};
+              border-radius:8px;padding:8px 14px;margin-bottom:16px;">
+      <span style="font-size:1.3em;">📄</span>
+      <strong>${pageCount} page${pageCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</strong>
+      ${pageWarning
+        ? '<span style="color:#d97706;font-size:0.88em;">⚠ Senior candidate target is 2–3 pages</span>'
+        : '<span style="color:#166534;font-size:0.88em;">✓ Good length</span>'}
+    </div>`;
+  }
+
+  if (atsError) {
+    html += `<div style="background:#fee2e2;border:1px solid #fca5a5;border-radius:8px;padding:12px 16px;margin-bottom:20px;">
+      <strong>⚠ ATS validation error:</strong> ${escapeHtml(atsError)}
+    </div>`;
+    return html;
+  }
+
+  if (!checks.length) {
+    return html;
+  }
+
+  const keywordFail = checks.some((check) => check.name === 'ats_keyword_presence' && check.status === 'fail');
+  const statusColour = summary.fail > 0 ? '#dc2626' : summary.warn > 0 ? '#d97706' : '#166534';
+  const statusIcon = summary.fail > 0 ? '❌' : summary.warn > 0 ? '⚠' : '✅';
+
+  html += `
+    <details open style="margin-bottom:20px;">
+      <summary style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:700;font-size:1em;padding:8px 0;color:${statusColour};">
+        ${statusIcon} ATS Report — ${summary.pass} pass, ${summary.warn} warn, ${summary.fail} fail
+      </summary>
+      <table class="review-table" style="margin-top:10px;font-size:0.87em;">
+        <thead><tr><th>Check</th><th>Format</th><th>Status</th><th>Detail</th></tr></thead>
+        <tbody>`;
+
+  for (const check of checks) {
+    const background = check.status === 'pass' ? '#f0fdf4' : check.status === 'warn' ? '#fef9c3' : '#fee2e2';
+    const icon = check.status === 'pass' ? '✅' : check.status === 'warn' ? '⚠' : '❌';
+    const formatBadge = `<span style="font-size:11px;background:#e0e7ff;color:#3730a3;border-radius:6px;padding:1px 5px;">${escapeHtml(check.format)}</span>`;
+
+    html += `<tr style="background:${background};">
+      <td style="font-weight:600;">${escapeHtml(check.label)}</td>
+      <td>${formatBadge}</td>
+      <td style="text-align:center;">${icon}</td>
+      <td><small>${escapeHtml(check.detail)}</small></td>
+    </tr>`;
+  }
+
+  html += '</tbody></table></details>';
+
+  if (summary.fail > 0) {
+    html += `<div style="background:#fee2e2;border:1px solid #fca5a5;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 16px;margin-bottom:20px;">
+      <strong>❌ Fix required:</strong> Some checks failed. Blocked formats are greyed out below.
+      ${keywordFail
+        ? '<br><strong>ATS keyword failure blocks all downloads</strong> — re-run customisations to improve keyword coverage.'
+        : ''}
+    </div>`;
+  }
+
+  return html;
+}
+
+function _renderDownloadGrid(files, checks, summary) {
+  const keywordFail = checks.some((check) => check.name === 'ats_keyword_presence' && check.status === 'fail');
+  const blockDocx = keywordFail || checks.some((check) => check.format === 'docx' && check.status === 'fail');
+  const blockHtml = keywordFail || checks.some((check) => check.format === 'html' && check.status === 'fail');
+  const blockPdf = keywordFail || checks.some((check) => check.format === 'pdf' && check.status === 'fail');
+
+  let html = '<div class="download-section"><div class="download-grid">';
+  if (!files.length) {
+    html += '<p>No downloadable files found. Please try generating your CV again.</p>';
+    html += '</div></div>';
+    return html;
+  }
+
+  for (const file of files) {
+    const blocked = (file.format === 'docx' && blockDocx)
+      || (file.format === 'html' && blockHtml)
+      || (file.format === 'pdf' && blockPdf);
+    const blockedStyle = blocked
+      ? 'cursor:not-allowed;opacity:0.4;background:#9ca3af;border-color:#9ca3af;'
+      : '';
+    const blockedMessage = blocked
+      ? '<div style="font-size:0.78em;color:#dc2626;margin-top:4px;">⛔ Blocked — fix ATS failures first</div>'
+      : '';
+
+    html += `
+      <div class="download-item" style="${blocked ? 'opacity:0.75;' : ''}">
+        <div class="download-icon">${file.icon}</div>
+        <div class="download-info">
+          <div class="download-name">${escapeHtml(file.filename)}</div>
+          <div class="download-description">${escapeHtml(file.description)}</div>
+          ${blockedMessage}
+        </div>
+        ${blocked
+          ? `<button class="btn-download" disabled style="${blockedStyle}">Blocked</button>`
+          : `<a href="/api/download/${encodeURIComponent(file.filename)}"
+                class="download-link" download="${escapeHtml(file.filename)}">
+              <button class="btn-download">Download</button>
+            </a>`}
+      </div>`;
+  }
+
+  html += '</div></div>';
+  if (summary.fail > 0 && files.length) {
+    html += '<p style="margin-top:12px;color:#6b7280;font-size:0.88em;">Blocked formats reflect ATS validation failures for the corresponding output types.</p>';
+  }
+  return html;
+}
+
+function _renderRefinementPanel() {
+  return `<div style="margin-top:24px;padding:16px;background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;
+            border-radius:8px;">
+    <div style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:10px;color:#374151;">↻ Iterative Refinement</div>
+    <div style="font-size:0.9em;color:#6b7280;margin-bottom:12px;">
+      Go back to refine an earlier step — all prior decisions and approvals are preserved.
+    </div>
+    <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
+      <button class="btn-secondary" onclick="backToPhase('customizations')" title="Return to Customisations step">
+        ↻ Refine Customisations
+      </button>
+      <button class="btn-secondary" onclick="backToPhase('rewrite')" title="Return to Rewrite Review step">
+        ↻ Refine Rewrites
+      </button>
+      <button class="btn-secondary" onclick="backToPhase('analysis')" title="Return to Analysis step">
+        ↻ Re-analyse Job
+      </button>
+    </div>
+  </div>`;
+}
+
+async function _fetchPersuasionHtml() {
+  try {
+    const response = await fetch('/api/persuasion-check');
+    const data = await response.json();
+    if (!response.ok || !data.ok) {
+      return '';
+    }
+
+    const summary = data.summary || { flagged: 0, strong_count: 0, total_bullets: 0 };
+    const findings = Array.isArray(data.findings) ? data.findings : [];
+    const scoreColor = summary.flagged === 0 ? '#10b981' : summary.flagged <= 3 ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444';
+    const scoreLabel = summary.flagged === 0
+      ? 'Excellent'
+      : summary.flagged <= 3
+        ? 'Good — minor improvements possible'
+        : 'Needs attention';
+
+    let html = `<div style="margin-top:20px;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
+      <div style="padding:14px 16px;background:#f8fafc;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;"
+           onclick="this.nextElementSibling.style.display=this.nextElementSibling.style.display==='none'?'block':'none'">
+        <div>
+          <span style="font-weight:600;color:#1f2937;">💪 Bullet Persuasiveness</span>
+          <span style="margin-left:12px;background:${scoreColor};color:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:2px 8px;font-size:0.8em;">${scoreLabel}</span>
+        </div>
+        <div style="font-size:0.85em;color:#6b7280;">
+          ${summary.strong_count}/${summary.total_bullets} strong · ${summary.flagged} flagged · click to ${summary.flagged > 0 ? 'expand' : 'collapse'}
+        </div>
+      </div>`;
+
+    if (findings.length > 0) {
+      html += `<div style="padding:12px 16px;display:${summary.flagged <= 3 ? 'block' : 'none'};">`;
+      for (const finding of findings) {
+        const severity = finding.severity === 'warning'
+          ? { background: '#fff7ed', border: '#f59e0b', label: '⚠ Warning' }
+          : { background: '#f0f9ff', border: '#3b82f6', label: 'ℹ Info' };
+        const truncatedText = finding.text && finding.text.length > 120
+          ? `${finding.text.slice(0, 120)}…`
+          : finding.text || '';
+        html += `<div style="margin-bottom:12px;padding:10px 12px;background:${severity.background};border-left:3px solid ${severity.border};border-radius:0 6px 6px 0;">
+          <div style="font-size:0.8em;color:#6b7280;margin-bottom:4px;">
+            <span style="background:${severity.border};color:#fff;border-radius:3px;padding:1px 6px;font-size:0.9em;">${severity.label}</span>
+            Bullet ${(finding.bullet_index ?? 0) + 1}${finding.exp_id ? ` · ${escapeHtml(finding.exp_id)}` : ''}
+          </div>
+          <div style="font-size:0.9em;color:#374151;margin-bottom:6px;">"${escapeHtml(truncatedText)}"</div>
+          <ul style="margin:0;padding-left:18px;">`;
+        for (const issue of finding.issues || []) {
+          html += `<li style="font-size:0.85em;color:#6b7280;margin-bottom:2px;">${escapeHtml(issue.suggestion)}</li>`;
+        }
+        html += '</ul></div>';
+      }
+      html += '</div>';
+    } else {
+      html += '<div style="padding:12px 16px;color:#10b981;font-size:0.9em;">All bullets meet persuasiveness criteria.</div>';
+    }
+
+    html += '</div>';
+    return html;
+  } catch (error) {
+    log.warn('Persuasion check failed:', error);
+    return '';
+  }
+}
+
+async function populateDownloadTab(cvData) {
+  stateManager.setTabData('cv', cvData);

+  const content = document.getElementById('document-content');

+
+  if (!cvData || (typeof cvData === 'object' && Object.keys(cvData).length === 0)) {
+    content.innerHTML = '<h1>⬇️ Download Generated Files</h1><div class="empty-state"><div class="icon">⬇️</div><h3>No Files Available</h3><p>Generate a CV first to see download options.</p></div>';

+  const files = _collectDownloadableFiles(cvData);

+      <strong>Output Directory:</strong> ${escapeHtml(cvData.output_dir)}
+    </div>`;
+  }
+
+  content.innerHTML = `${html}<p style="color:#6b7280;margin-top:16px;font-size:0.9em;">Analysing bullet persuasiveness…</p>`;
+  html += await _fetchPersuasionHtml();
+  html += _renderRefinementPanel();
+  content.innerHTML = html;
+}
+
+export { populateDownloadTab };

            normalized.append(bullet.strip())
        elif isinstance(bullet, dict):
            normalized.append((bullet.get('text') or bullet.get('description') or bullet.get('content') or '').strip())
    master_map[(title.strip(), company.strip())] = normalized

experiences = []
for header in soup.select('div.job-entry, div.experience-entry, section.job-entry'):
    title_el = header.select_one('.job-title')
    company_el = header.select_one('.job-company')
    if not title_el or not company_el:
        continue
    bullets = [li.get_text(' ', strip=True) for li in header.select('li')]
    experiences.append(((title_el.get_text(' ', strip=True), company_el.get_text(' ', strip=True)), bullets))

print('parsed experiences', len(experiences))
for (title, company), bullets in experiences:

    extra = [b for b in bullets if b not in master_bullets]
    missing = [b for b in master_bullets if b not in bullets]
    if extra or missing:
        print('\nEXPERIENCE', title, '@', company)

                print('   -', bullet)
        if missing:
            print('  MISSING FROM HTML:')
            for bullet in missing:
                print('   -', bullet)

+    def _get_experience_achievement_texts(self, experience_index: int) -> List[str]:
+        """Return plain-text achievements for one master CV experience."""
+        master_data = getattr(self.orchestrator, 'master_data', None) or {}
+        experiences = master_data.get('experience') or []
+        if not (0 <= experience_index < len(experiences)):
+            return []
+
+        experience = experiences[experience_index] or {}
+        achievements = experience.get('key_achievements') or experience.get('achievements') or []
+
+        texts: List[str] = []
+        for achievement in achievements:
+            if isinstance(achievement, str):
+                texts.append(achievement)
+                continue
+            if isinstance(achievement, dict):
+                texts.append(
+                    achievement.get('text')
+                    or achievement.get('description')
+                    or achievement.get('content')
+                    or ''
+                )
+                continue
+            texts.append('')
+        return texts
+
+    def _persist_accepted_achievement_rewrite(
+        self,
+        experience_index: int,
+        achievement_index: int,
+        accepted_text: str,
+    ) -> bool:
+        """Persist an accepted rewrite into session achievement edits immediately."""
+        if not accepted_text:
+            return False
+        if experience_index < 0 or achievement_index < 0:
+            return False
+
+        raw_edits = self.state.get('achievement_edits') or {}
+        normalized_edits: Dict[int, List[str]] = {}
+        for key, value in raw_edits.items():
+            try:
+                exp_idx = int(key)
+            except (TypeError, ValueError):
+                continue
+            normalized_edits[exp_idx] = list(value) if isinstance(value, list) else [str(value)]
+
+        edits = normalized_edits.get(experience_index)
+        if edits is None:
+            edits = self._get_experience_achievement_texts(experience_index)
+        else:
+            edits = list(edits)
+
+        while len(edits) <= achievement_index:
+            edits.append('')
+
+        edits[achievement_index] = accepted_text
+        normalized_edits[experience_index] = edits
+        self.state['achievement_edits'] = normalized_edits
+        return True

The layout-instruction finding from the broad sweep is a false alarm: `/api/cv/layout-refine` persists each instruction into `generation_state.layout_instructions`, and the restore path reads it back through `/api/layout-history`. The real risk I’m seeing instead is stale client-side session data surviving when the restored backend status omits a field.

I’ve narrowed the remaining risk to restore semantics, not backend persistence writes. The pattern repeats in a few places: client session state is only overwritten when the restored payload has data, which means empty or missing server fields can leave stale analysis/customization/CV state hanging around.

## 🔴 **Three Concrete Bugs Identified** 

### **BUG #1: Layout Instructions Lost on Page Reload (HIGH SEVERITY)**

**File/Function**: [web/layout-instruction.js](web/layout-instruction.js#L387-L400) `addToInstructionHistory()`

**What's Wrong**: 
- When a user applies a layout instruction, the frontend updates the HTML AND adds the instruction to the client-side global `window.layoutInstructions`
- **BUT** it never makes an API call to persist this to the server session state
- Only when `/api/layout-complete` is called (final step) are instructions sent to backend
- **Consequence**: If page refreshes, session times out, or server resets between instructions, all intermediate instructions are lost in client state only

**Why It's a Bug**: Layout instructions represent user work during Phase 12. They should persist through page reloads. They don't.

**Impact**: User applies "Move Publications after Skills" → refreshes page → instruction vanishes.

---

- If an older session is loaded with the old key, some code paths could miss the data

**Why It's a Bug**: Inconsistent handling of key names creates silent data loss risk for sessions migrated from older code.

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="create_file"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **create_file**</summary>

**Input:**

- content:

```
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const repo = '/Users/warnes/src/cv-builder';
const webDir = path.join(repo, 'web');
const files = fs.readdirSync(webDir)
  .filter(name => name.endsWith('.js') || name === 'index.html')
  .map(name => path.join(webDir, name));

const onclickFns = new Map();
const idButtons = [];

for (const file of files) {
  const text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
  for (const match of text.matchAll(/onclick="([A-Za-z0-9_$]+)\(/g)) {
    const fnName = match[1];
    if (!onclickFns.has(fnName)) onclickFns.set(fnName, []);
    onclickFns.get(fnName).push(path.relative(repo, file));
  }
  for (const match of text.matchAll(/<button[^>]*\sid="([^"]+)"[^>]*>/g)) {
    idButtons.push({ id: match[1], file: path.relative(repo, file) });
  }
}

const mainText = fs.readFileSync(path.join(webDir, 'src', 'main.js'), 'utf8');
const moduleFiles = [...mainText.matchAll(/import \* as [A-Za-z0-9_$]+ from '\.\.\/([^']+)'/g)]
  .map(match => path.join(webDir, match[1]));

const exportedFns = new Set();
for (const file of moduleFiles) {
  const text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
  for (const match of text.matchAll(/export\s+function\s+([A-Za-z0-9_$]+)/g)) exportedFns.add(match[1]);
  for (const match of text.matchAll(/export\s+(?:const|let|var)\s+([A-Za-z0-9_$]+)\s*=/g)) exportedFns.add(match[1]);
  for (const match of text.matchAll(/export\s*\{([^}]+)\}/g)) {
    for (const part of match[1].split(',')) {
      const trimmed = part.trim();
      if (!trimmed) continue;
      const aliasParts = trimmed.split(/\s+as\s+/);
      exportedFns.add((aliasParts[1] || aliasParts[0]).trim());
    }
  }
}

const missingInline = [...onclickFns.keys()].filter(name => !exportedFns.has(name)).sort();

const singleRefIds = [];
const zeroRefIds = [];
for (const { id, file } of idButtons) {
  if (file !== 'web/index.html') continue;
  let count = 0;
  const spots = [];
  for (const jsFile of [...moduleFiles, path.join(webDir, 'app.js')]) {
    const text = fs.readFileSync(jsFile, 'utf8');
    const escaped = id.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
    const matches = text.match(new RegExp(escaped, 'g'));
    const c = matches ? matches.length : 0;
    if (c) {
      count += c;
      spots.push(`${path.basename(jsFile)}:${c}`);
    }
  }
  if (count === 0) zeroRefIds.push(id);
  else if (count === 1) singleRefIds.push({ id, spots });
}

console.log(JSON.stringify({
  inlineOnclickTotal: onclickFns.size,
  missingInline,
  zeroRefIds,
  singleRefIds,
}, null, 2));

```

<summary>Tool use: **create_file**</summary>

**Input:**

- content:

```
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const repo = '/Users/warnes/src/cv-builder';
const webDir = path.join(repo, 'web');
const mainJs = path.join(webDir, 'src', 'main.js');
const indexHtml = path.join(webDir, 'index.html');

const moduleFiles = [...fs.readFileSync(mainJs, 'utf8').matchAll(/import \* as [A-Za-z0-9_$]+ from '\.\.\/([^']+)'/g)]
  .map(match => path.join(webDir, match[1]));
const allJsFiles = [...new Set([...moduleFiles, path.join(webDir, 'app.js')])];

const exportedNames = new Set();
for (const file of moduleFiles) {
  const text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
  for (const match of text.matchAll(/export\s+(?:async\s+)?function\s+([A-Za-z0-9_$]+)/g)) exportedNames.add(match[1]);
  for (const match of text.matchAll(/export\s+(?:const|let|var)\s+([A-Za-z0-9_$]+)\s*=/g)) exportedNames.add(match[1]);
  for (const match of text.matchAll(/export\s*\{([^}]+)\}/g)) {
    for (const rawPart of match[1].split(',')) {
      const part = rawPart.trim();
      if (!part) continue;
      const alias = part.split(/\s+as\s+/);
      exportedNames.add((alias[1] || alias[0]).trim());
    }
  }
}

const html = fs.readFileSync(indexHtml, 'utf8');
const buttonRegex = /<button\b([^>]*)>([\s\S]*?)<\/button>/g;
const buttonFindings = [];
let match;
while ((match = buttonRegex.exec(html))) {
  const attrs = match[1];
  const text = match[2].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const idMatch = attrs.match(/\sid="([^"]+)"/);
  const onclickMatch = attrs.match(/onclick="([^"]+)"/);
  const id = idMatch ? idMatch[1] : null;
  const onclick = onclickMatch ? onclickMatch[1] : null;
  let jsRefs = [];
  if (id) {
    for (const file of allJsFiles) {
      const fileText = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
      if (fileText.includes(id)) jsRefs.push(path.relative(repo, file));
    }
  }
  let inlineStatus = null;
  if (onclick) {
    const fnMatch = onclick.match(/^([A-Za-z0-9_$]+)\(/);
    if (fnMatch) {
      const fnName = fnMatch[1];
      inlineStatus = exportedNames.has(fnName) || fs.readFileSync(path.join(webDir, 'app.js'), 'utf8').includes(`function ${fnName}`)
        ? 'ok'
        : 'missing-export';
    } else {
      inlineStatus = 'expression';
    }
  }
  const wired = Boolean(onclick) || jsRefs.length > 0;
  buttonFindings.push({ id, text, onclick, inlineStatus, jsRefs, wired });
}

const suspicious = buttonFindings.filter(btn => !btn.wired || btn.inlineStatus === 'missing-export');
console.log(JSON.stringify({
  totalButtons: buttonFindings.length,
  suspicious,
}, null, 2));

```
